title: When 54gene Closed, Its Biobank Became the Unfinished Question
conflicts: Biobank size: over 130,000 samples (company, October 2022), capacity over 300,000 (TechCrunch, August 2022), over 200,000 (WeeTracker), biodata of 100,000 Nigerians (2025 court documents via TechCabal); story uses the company figure for the biobank and the court-document figure for the assets offered for sale, both attributed. Ene-Obong's exit: 'decided to step down' (company, 2022), 'a difficult and emotional decision' (Ene-Obong, 2023), forced out (his 2025 petition); first two quoted, the third only as part of his petition allegations.
notes: Told as a closure with every disputed claim attributed: Ene-Obong's 2025 petition allegations against Cathay AfricInvest and Adjuvant are summarised as his allegations, with Adjuvant's reply and Cathay's non-response; the court injunction is reported as blocking the sale pending judgment. Left out: the 2022 unproven allegations against Ene-Obong (withdrawn by TechCrunch), the former interim CEO's lawsuit, and anonymous claims about unpaid creditors and COVID revenue. The founder was not chief executive during the 2023 wind-down (Chiarello was), which the story makes clear. This is the batch's one talQen mention, in the reflection, on sample and record custody.
